prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 团队周报看板（第 34 周） (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "成员" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 2: header "状态" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 54px
  col 3: header "本周完成" · longest unbreakable word 58px · one-line width 679px
  col 4: header "下周计划" · longest unbreakable word 44px · one-line width 934px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"汇总第 34 周各成员的工作状态、本周成果与下周计划，帮助团队识别进展、风险和阻塞。","reading":"读者先按成员逐行查看状态，再横向关联本周完成与下周计划；也会纵向扫描状态以定位风险和阻塞。长文本换行后应保持每一行仍易于辨认。","groups":["成员与状态共同构成每行的快速索引。","本周完成与下周计划是一对时间相邻的叙述列，需要并排比较；下周计划的单行内容更长。"],"keep_intact":["成员姓名","状态图标与状态文字","数字、百分比、英文缩写及专有名词等不宜拆开的内容"],"may_wrap":["本周完成和下周计划中的中文叙述可在自然语义边界换行；同一行中较短的单元格可利用另一叙述列产生的行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [67, 75, 270, 307] · table 720×604px · row heights [36, 106, 106, 106, 83, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [67, 75, 245, 332] · table 720×604px · row heights [36, 106, 106, 106, 83, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [67, 75, 280, 297] · table 720×604px · row heights [36, 106, 106, 106, 83, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"成员与状态列紧凑且完整，图标和文字便于纵向扫描；两列叙述并排，计划列稍宽，符合内容长度差异。表头完整，行边界清楚，没有单词中途拆分。","problems":"部分换行落在词组或数量与单位之间，如“3／个”和“人／工介入”，影响连续阅读；几行左侧三行、右侧四行，单元格底部留白不均。","cause":"本周完成列为270px、下周计划列为307px，文本可用宽度分别为249px和286px，换行点恰好落在这些位置。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"332px的计划列使多数计划叙述较舒展；成员、状态和表头均保持完整，行与行之间清晰。","problems":"完成列明显偏窄，风险行增至四行，多个词组被拆开；计划列首行将“500”和“TPS”分到两行，末行还孤留一个“界”字。两叙述列宽度差距较大，横向比较的节奏偏斜。","cause":"245px的完成列仅有224px文本空间；332px的计划列虽更宽，其311px文本空间却使首行末尾落在“500 TPS”和“边界”之间。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"280px的完成列使风险行回到三行，完成列整体比r1B更舒展；成员与状态完整，表头不换行，行边界清晰。","problems":"297px的计划列仍需四行容纳前三条计划，且“提／前归档”等词组跨行；相较r1A，完成列增加的空间没有改善整体行高，计划列却更紧。","cause":"完成列较r1A增加10px、计划列减少10px；计划文本较长，276px的可用文本宽度使若干词组落在行尾。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r2A","widths":[67,75,260,317],"change":"以r1A为基础，将10px从完成列转给计划列，尝试改善计划列词组断行，同时保留较均衡的叙述列比例。"},{"name":"r2B","widths":[67,75,255,322],"change":"在r1A与r1B之间探索，给更长的计划内容更多空间，同时避免r1B完成列过窄；重点检查风险行及“500 TPS”的换行。"},{"name":"r2C","widths":[67,75,290,287],"change":"尝试更均衡的叙述列比例，检验加宽完成列能否改善词组完整性，以及计划列变窄后是否仍保持可读。"}]}
